children: BlackRock Greater Europe Investment Trust plc (‘the Company’)
Transaction in own shares: purchase of own shares to be held in treasury
The Company announces that it has today purchased 25,853 of its Ordinary Shares at an average price of 598.49 pence per share to be held in treasury.

Following settlement of this purchase on 03 September 2026 the issued share capital of the Company will be 89,695,459 Ordinary Shares, excluding 28,233,479 shares which are held in treasury.
       
      Shares held in treasury do not carry any voting rights; 23.94% of the Company’s total issued share capital (117,928,938 Ordinary Shares, including treasury shares) will be held in treasury following settlement.

For reporting purposes under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules the market should exclude any shares held in treasury and should use the figure of 89,695,459 following settlement when determining if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company.
